description: This header file defines the interface IStorageManager within the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace. It declares virtual methods for managing storage associated with applications, including creating, retrieving, deleting, and clearing storage, with comments and annotations indicating JSON serialization and stub generation details.

classes.name: IStorageManager
classes.description: An interface for storage management, providing methods for creating, retrieving, deleting, and clearing application storage resources.

methods.name: CreateStorage
methods.description: Creates storage for a specified application, returning the storage path or an error reason.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the storage location details for a specified application, including path, size, and used space.

methods.name: DeleteStorage
methods.description: Deletes the storage associated with a specified application.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears storage data for a specified application, also affecting device storage.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears storage data for all applications except for exemption list.
